title: WaypointWireDto
description: External Wire DTO for waypoint mutations.

difficulty.description: Target difficulty (0 = Normal, 1 = Nightmare, 2 = Hell). If None, applies to all unlocked/all difficulties.

unlock_all.description: If true, unlocks all waypoints in the target difficulty (or all difficulties if difficulty is None).

activate_waypoints.description: Explicit list of waypoint names to activate.
